history.content: Can I afford a $400 trip to Austin next weekend?

Here's what I can actually see, Alex: of what you've logged with me this week, you're at $395 of a $400 budget, $275 dining and $120 Amazon. So by your own logged numbers, you're essentially at your cap, and a $400 trip would put the week at ~$795. I have not actually checked your calendar yet, so I cannot say whether it is reachable. If you want, I can check flights/hotels for Austin next weekend and see what the real total would be, or we treat it as next month's spend instead. Which way?
